One person has died and three people have been taken to hospital after the car they were travelling in struck a tree on Sunday night. (ABC News)

One person has died and three others have been taken to hospital after a crash at Ballarat in Victoria's west overnight.

Police said a car left the road and struck a tree near the corner of Skipton and Doveton streets at Ballarat just before 10pm.

Police say the car left the road near the corner of Doveton and Skipton streets in Ballarat.  (ABC News)

Police said the front seat passenger died at the scene and the driver was flown to hospital with life-threatening injuries.

Two other passengers were taken to hospital with minor injuries.

An investigation is underway.

Witnesses or anyone with information are urged to contact CrimeStoppers.
